notes: Staged on Andrew's word (2026-10-26, night: "Pick correct color and size and add it to the app, show me locally. also push up deploy"): the Tumble set is in the staged room; the rugless room is kept as the Rugless variant. Andrew, 2026-10-26 (night): "I think we need something like a ruggable so that it's thin enough and separate from the padding to allow actually washing." Layout J with the two-piece system in place of the one-piece AMADA: Tumble's Sophia Ivory/Beige 8x10 ($399, cushioned pad included), a distressed Persian floral in ivory and beige with light gold, terracotta and green motifs. Same footprint, x 40 to 160, y 22 to 118 (rot 90): under the king's lower 70", 8" out each side, 50" past the foot under the bench, 19" off the heater (F-33). Color (F-68): behind its own door the room is warm (walnut, oatmeal, sage), so it takes its own warm field, the green motif answering the sage throw; not a repeat of the dining room's gray. Ruggable's flatwoven Hendesi Heriz Cream 8x10 is $579 with its pad. The staged A stays rugless until Eutine chooses. Andrew, later that night: "tumble rug is orderable on amazon! pretty convenient we should prefer that unless ruggable is way better or something": the rug placed is the Amazon listing amazon-B0HCN4GKK1 ($399, ships in 4 to 5 days, free delivery November 9, as read 2026-10-26), the same set at the same price; Ruggable's flatwoven is judged not clearly better (thinner cover, $180 more per 8x10, made to order, the same robot-vacuum caveat), so Tumble it is (F-69).
